shared_elements: long pleated/draped robes reaching the feet
figure holding an upright staff or spear
hand raised holding a bowl or vessel
row of figures aligned along a single horizontal register
low relief with incised linear detailing of hair/beard and drapery folds
justification: Both surfaces depict processional friezes of robed, bearded human figures shown in strict profile, striding along a single register, with the very specific combination of an upright staff/spear gripped vertically at one side and a raised hand presenting a bowl-like vessel, rendered in shallow relief with the same convention of long parallel incised drapery folds and finely striated hair. The main difference in content is that A is a uniform repeated file of near-identical figures all facing the same way, whereas B shows a hierarchic encounter with a larger staff-bearing figure confronted by a smaller attendant offering the vessel.
